text: My partner and I are marking on our calendar to go vote together and he will vote. We would hopefully contribute a little to make Israeli society more open and accepting of foreign partners living here. Unfortunately, I do feel that the racism has increased recently, and sometimes even feel that my life is threatened just because of my "asian+woman" tag. 2 times I was driving in relatively safe areas with windows open, and some men saw me as a driver and came to my window and shouted to scare me. .. it was horrifying... and also unrespectful pickup lines from random guys on the street. Some lady here said she never felt discriminated, i do not agree, and I sincerely hope that with this election, things will slowly be corrected and this will be the feeling for more of us to be proud of medina israel than struggling in all aspects of our daily life.
